sm_name: The State Trading Corporation of India Limited
voiceSummary: The State Trading Corporation of India Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report. The Independent Auditor issued a qualified conclusion on the financial statements. The report highlights several material misstatements and non-provisions. These include an overstatement of profit by Rs. 1.67 lacs due to asset handling issues with Mumbai Port Trust. Trade receivables of Rs. 1,69,953.87 lacs are considered doubtful, leading to an understatement of provisions by Rs. 1,07,226.25 lacs. Claims recoverable of Rs. 3,202.47 lacs were not written off. The company also faces penalties of approximately Rs. 175.90 Lakhs for non-compliance with SEBI regulations. The results are subject to the auditor's final review findings.
